step5.title: Ready to play?

tutorial.instructionHit: Tap Hit to draw a card.
tutorial.instructionStand: Tap Stand to keep your hand.
tutorial.instructionDouble: Good hand to double. Tap Double.
tutorial.instructionSwap: Bad hand against the dealer: Swap shows up. Tap to redeal it.

round1.body: You draw the perfect card and win.

round2.title: Nice
round2.body: Standing on a strong hand was the right call.

round3.title: Good call
round3.body: On a strong hand, Double raises your bet — and can raise your win.

round4.title: Blackjack!
round4.body: Swap only shows up on a bad hand. New hand, instant blackjack!

round5.title: Not this time
round5.body: Going over 21 is an automatic loss. Happens to everyone!
